$comment: The class contract of a pre-rendered diagram, the one copy. A drawing is an <svg class="dg dg-<kind>"> inside <figure class="diagram">; every primitive in it carries one of the classes below and nothing else: no <style>, no style=, no paint or font attribute, its text as SVG <text>. hdtp-spec's site/spec-html.mjs emits exactly these classes and audits every build against its committed copy of this file, held equal to this one by its gate when the repositories are side by side; kit/docs.css styles exactly these; README.md's tables under Diagrams are this file rendered; test/docs.test.mjs holds the stylesheet and the tables to it. A class is a part, then a role, then modifiers; a line carries its part alone. "text" is the size and weight every label was laid out at, so the stylesheet draws the text the boxes were measured for: a label not listed takes dg-label's.

figure.diagram: the `<figure>` around one drawing, with an optional `<figcaption>`

svg.dg: the `<svg>`: the page's sans (Inter), scaled to the column, overflow visible; line weights do not scale with it
svg.dg-flowchart: with `dg`: the drawing is a flowchart
svg.dg-state: with `dg`: the drawing is a state diagram
svg.dg-sequence: with `dg`: the drawing is a sequence diagram

parts.dg-node: a box: a flowchart's node, a state, a start or end mark
parts.dg-cluster: a group: a subgraph, a composite state
parts.dg-edge: a connection: a flowchart's or a state diagram's edge, a sequence diagram's message
parts.dg-actor: a sequence diagram's participant, drawn at the top and again at the bottom
parts.dg-frame: a sequence diagram's loop, alt or opt frame: its sides, its tag, its dividers
parts.dg-number: a sequence number: the disc, the digit, and the zero-length line that carries the disc's marker

roles.dg-shape: what is drawn: a rect, polygon, circle, path, or a stick figure's lines
roles.dg-bg: the ground behind a connection's label, knocking the line out

modifiers.dg-dashed: dashed: a reply, a frame's divider
modifiers.dg-terminal: a state diagram's start or end mark

dg-node dg-shape dg-terminal.draws: a start or end mark: ink

dg-cluster dg-shape.draws: a group: cream, dashed faint stroke

dg-edge dg-bg.draws: the ground behind a connection's label: the page's background

dg-actor dg-shape.draws: a participant, as a box or a stick figure: white, ink stroke

dg-frame dg-dashed.draws: a frame's divider, between an alt and its else: faint, dashed

dg-frame dg-shape.draws: a frame's tag, the box saying loop or alt: cream, faint stroke

dg-frame dg-label.draws: a frame's tag and its condition: ink

dg-number.draws: the carrier of a sequence number's marker: nothing
